name: Raccoon Girl Becca
source:
Becca insists she's a raccoon girl—although last time Hugh checked raccoons weren't quite so orange...

Regardless, she's digging through his trash again, and that usually ends in a hangout!

[From [url=https://demonward.itch.io/raccoon-girl-becca]itch.io[/url]]
